# Working together

Treat every participant with respect, including people whose experience, language, disability, identity, or technical background differs from yours. Critique work with evidence and explain the practical effect of a proposed change. Make space for domain knowledge and lived experience.

Harassment, threats, discriminatory conduct, sexualized behavior, doxxing, unwanted contact, and knowingly exposing private information are unacceptable. Never use the mission to pressure someone into unpaid work or imply that their availability measures their worth.

Maintainers should address concerns privately where possible, preserve only necessary evidence, disclose conflicts, and use proportionate responses. Possible actions include a clarification, warning, participation restriction, or removal. Urgent safety concerns can justify an immediate temporary restriction followed by review. Appeals should be heard by an unconflicted institutional steward.

Before opening participation publicly, appoint conduct stewards and publish a private reporting channel. This foundation does not invent a contact address or claim an appointed enforcement team.
